title: UI/UX Developer
description:
**About RupeeQ**

RupeeQ is a lending and financial services platform that helps customers explore financial products and connect with banks and NBFCs. Our products include personal loans, business loans, debt consolidation, credit cards, and other credit solutions.

We are improving our website, mobile app, customer journeys, and internal platforms to make financial services easier to understand and access. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can turn complex requirements into clear, practical, and visually consistent experiences.

**About the Role**

You will work on RupeeQ’s customer-facing website and app, along with internal tools used by sales, operations, and management teams.

Your responsibility will go beyond designing individual screens. You should understand what a user is trying to achieve, identify where they may face confusion, and design the complete journey—from the first interaction to application completion and status tracking.

For example, a customer applying for a loan should understand what information is required, why it is needed, what happens next, and how to resolve an error. An employee using an internal dashboard should be able to identify the next action quickly.

This role requires hands-on design work, attention to detail, and ownership through development and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities1. Understand Users, Products & Business Requirements**

● Understand RupeeQ’s financial products, customer profiles, and application processes.

● Work with business, product, sales, operations, and technology teams to gather requirements.

● Ask questions to clarify the user’s objective, business purpose, required information, and expected outcome before starting designs.

● Translate business requirements and lender requirements into journeys that customers can understand.

● Consider different user groups, including first-time borrowers, returning customers, and internal employees.

● Document assumptions and identify missing requirements early.

**2. Design Complete Customer Journeys**

Design clear journeys across RupeeQ’s website and app, including:

● Product discovery and product information pages.

● Registration, login, OTP verification, and account recovery.

● Customer profile creation and application forms.

● Eligibility checks and lender offer comparisons.

● Loan amount, tenure, EMI, fees, and repayment information.

● Document upload, banking information, KYC, and verification steps.

● Consent screens and transitions to lender platforms.

● Application progress, pending actions, and status tracking.

● Support, complaints, and service requests.

● Credit score and credit health experiences, where required.

Your designs should also cover customers who are ineligible, have no available offers, leave an application incomplete, or encounter technical issues.

**3. Create User Flows, Wireframes & Prototypes**

● Map user journeys and define the sequence of screens and actions.

● Organise information so users can find what they need easily.

● Create low-fidelity wireframes before investing time in detailed visual design.

● Build interactive Figma prototypes to demonstrate navigation, interactions, and decision points.

● Explore alternatives when a journey is complex and explain your recommended approach.

● Incorporate feedback while maintaining clarity and consistency.

**4. Deliver High-Quality UI Designs**

● Create polished, high-fidelity designs for mobile apps, websites, landing pages, dashboards, and internal tools.

● Apply consistent typography, spacing, colours, icons, and visual hierarchy.

● Design responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

● Account for Android and iOS interaction patterns where relevant.

● Keep screens readable and usable for customers with different levels of digital confidence.

● Use animation and micro-interactions where they help users understand feedback or progress.

**5. Simplify Forms & Improve Application Completion**

● Break lengthy forms into manageable steps.

● Choose suitable input types, field labels, instructions, and validation patterns.

● Clearly distinguish mandatory and optional information.

● Design helpful error messages that explain how to correct an issue.

● Reduce unnecessary repetition and make it easy to review or edit information.

● Consider interrupted journeys, saved progress, and returning users.

● Suggest improvements to reduce confusion and application drop-offs.

**6. Design for Trust & Clear Financial Communication**

● Present financial information in a readable and understandable format.

● Make important details—such as interest rates, fees, EMI, tenure, and next steps—easy to locate.

● Clearly communicate when a customer is moving from RupeeQ to a lender’s platform.

● Design consent and permission requests with clear explanations and visible choices.

● Work with the relevant teams to accommodate approved disclosures, privacy notices, and grievance information.

● Avoid misleading visual emphasis, hidden conditions, or confusing choices.

**7. Design Internal Platforms & Dashboards**

● Design practical interfaces for RupeeQ’s LMS, CRM, and operational tools.

● Understand how agents, team leaders, operations teams, and managers use these systems.

● Create clear lead lists, customer profiles, application views, follow-up screens, and task queues.

● Design usable tables, filters, search, sorting, pagination, and bulk actions.

● Present business and operational information with a clear hierarchy.

● Consider role-based views and permissions when defining available actions.

● Reduce unnecessary clicks and make frequent tasks easier to complete.

**8. Build & Maintain a Design System**

● Create reusable Figma components, variants, styles, and layout patterns.

● Maintain consistency across RupeeQ’s website, app, and internal platforms.

● Define standard buttons, form fields, cards, navigation, tables, alerts, and other common elements.

● Include interaction states such as default, selected, disabled, loading, success, and error.

● Keep components organised and document their intended use.

● Update the design system as products evolve.

**9. Conduct Practical Research & Usability Checks**

● Review existing journeys and identify usability problems.

● Gather feedback from customers and internal teams.

● Conduct basic user interviews, walkthroughs, and task-based usability tests.

● Observe where users hesitate, make errors, or need assistance.

● Review available feedback and product analytics to identify opportunities for improvement.

● Explain findings and recommend actionable changes.

● Review competitor products to understand common patterns and identify useful opportunities.

**10. Collaborate with Developers & Verify Implementation**

● Prepare organised Figma files with clear naming, components, assets, and specifications.

● Explain responsive behaviour, interactions, validation rules, and screen states.

● Discuss technical constraints with developers and find practical solutions.

● Remain available during implementation to resolve questions.

● Review developed screens against approved designs.

● Check layouts, spacing, typography, responsiveness, and interaction behaviour.

● Track design issues and follow through until they are resolved.

**11. Take Ownership of Delivery**

● Break assignments into clear tasks and realistic delivery timelines.

● Communicate progress, dependencies, and blockers promptly.

● Manage feedback from multiple stakeholders and maintain version clarity.

● Balance design quality with development effort and business priorities.

● Take responsibility for a feature from requirement discussion through implementation review.

● Continuously improve your skills and apply relevant learning to RupeeQ’s products.

**Required Skills & ExperienceUI/UX Fundamentals**

● 2–3 years of hands-on UI/UX design experience.

● Understanding of user-centred design, information architecture, interaction design, and usability.

● Ability to connect individual screens into a complete, logical journey.

● Strong visual design skills, including typography, spacing, alignment, colour, and hierarchy.

● Ability to explain design decisions using user needs and business requirements.

**Figma Proficiency**

You should be comfortable using:

● Auto Layout and responsive constraints.

● Components, variants, and reusable styles.

● Interactive prototypes.

● Shared libraries and organised design files.

● Developer handoff features.

● Variables or design tokens; practical familiarity is an advantage.

**Website & Mobile App Design**

● Experience designing responsive websites and mobile app interfaces.

● Understanding of navigation, forms, onboarding, and common mobile interaction patterns.

● Ability to design for different screen sizes and content lengths.

● Awareness of touch targets, readable text, keyboard behaviour, and mobile input constraints.

**Complete Screen States**

Your work should account for:

● Loading and processing.

● Empty states and unavailable information.

● Success and confirmation.

● Validation errors and failed requests.

● Disabled actions.

● Network interruptions and retry options.

● Pending verification or incomplete steps.

**Accessibility Awareness**

● Understanding of readable typography, colour contrast, clear labels, and usable touch targets.

● Ability to communicate status and errors without relying only on colour.

● Awareness of keyboard navigation and screen-reader considerations.

● Willingness to apply accessibility requirements during design and implementation reviews.

**Communication & Collaboration**

● Ability to understand requirements and ask relevant questions.

● Clear communication with business teams and developers.

● Openness to feedback and willingness to revise designs thoughtfully.

● Ability to work across multiple tasks, manage priorities, and meet agreed deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

● Experience with fintech, lending, banking, insurance, or other financial products.

● Experience designing multi-step applications, KYC journeys, document uploads, or offer comparisons.

● Experience with CRM, LMS, dashboards, or other internal business tools.

● Familiarity with conversion funnels, product analytics, and usability testing.

● Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and frontend constraints.

● Experience creating or maintaining a design system.

● Experience in a startup or another environment where requirements evolve quickly.

**Relevant fintech experience is an advantage. Candidates with strong work on similarly complex products are also welcome.**

**What We Expect from You at RupeeQ**

● **Think beyond appearance:** Make journeys understandable and useful.

● **Understand before designing:** Clarify the problem and required behaviour.

● **Own the details:** Include errors, edge cases, and responsive behaviour.

● **Work at a practical pace:** Deliver usable designs within agreed timelines.

● **Stay involved:** Support development and review the final implementation.

● **Learn independently:** Strengthen your skills and bring useful ideas to the team.

● **Connect design to outcomes:** Help customers complete tasks and employees work more efficiently.

**How Your Work Will Be Evaluated**

Your contribution will be assessed through:

● Clarity and usability of the journeys you design.

● Visual quality and consistency across products.

● Completeness of designs and supporting states.

● Quality of Figma files and developer handoff.

● Timely delivery and ownership of assigned work.

● Collaboration and responsiveness to feedback.

● Improvements supported by user feedback, usability checks, or available product data.

**Portfolio Requirements**

Please share a portfolio that helps us understand **your contribution and your thinking**.

Where possible, include 2–3 relevant projects covering:

● The problem and intended users.

● Your role and specific responsibilities.

● User flows, wireframes, or early explorations.

● Final designs and prototypes.

● Important decisions and constraints.

● What was implemented, tested, or improved.

If a project was completed as part of a team, clearly identify the work you personally handled. If results were not measured, explain what you learned without assuming an impact.

**How to Apply**

Please share:

● Your updated resume.

● Your portfolio link.

● Links to relevant Figma prototypes or case studies, if available.

● Your current location and notice period.

● Your current and expected salary.

● Confirmation of your availability for a full-time, on-site role in Noida.

**Applicants without a portfolio may not be considered. Please ensure shared links are accessible.**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹38,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: 4809- Senior Manager- Product Designer
description:
**About the team**

Innovaccer builds AI agents for healthcare that automate administrative work, so care teams can get back to care. As a Senior Manager, you'll lead the team designing autonomous experiences for healthcare. You'll lead designers across related product areas, partner with product and engineering leaders to shape direction, and stay close to the work. Your impact will show up in the team you build, the quality of the experiences it ships, and the outcomes those experiences create.

**Product Management at Innovaccer**

The Product team at Innovaccer designs AI-native solutions for healthcare providers, payers, and government organizations: agentic workflows that automate complex clinical and operational processes, intelligent systems that replace manual work at scale, and data infrastructure that makes all of it possible. Every product decision here is a bet on what AI-native healthcare infrastructure needs to look like next, positioning Innovaccer as the autonomous operations platform leader.

If you think in systems, work well with ambiguity, and want your output to have real stakes, this team is where you will do your best work.

**Build and grow the team**

* Manage, coach, and develop product designers through regular feedback, clear goals, and career conversations
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and team health. Build a team with diverse strengths and perspectives
* Plan design capacity with product and engineering, making clear choices about priorities and ownership
* Create a culture of trust, direct feedback, and accountability. Help designers grow their judgment and independence

**Shape product direction**

* Partner with product and engineering leaders to define problems, shape roadmaps, and agree on success measures across your product areas
* Use customer research, product data, and domain knowledge to challenge assumptions and guide decisions
* Bring coherence to data-dense clinical and operational workflows, including permissions

exceptions, and dependencies across products

* Favor small, testable releases. Measure usability, adoption, and task success, and improve the experience after launch

**Raise the craft bar**

* Lead specific, actionable critiques across interaction design, information architecture, visual design, accessibility, and content
* Stay hands-on when it helps the team move forward: pair on difficult problems, explore alternatives, and build prototypes
* Partner with engineering throughout implementation to protect quality, resolve tradeoffs, and address edge cases
* Strengthen shared components and patterns across Figma and code. Help teams reuse and contribute to the design system

**Evolve how we design with AI**

* Use AI tools such as Claude to explore ideas, prototype workflows, and shorten feedback loops. Help the team develop effective practices
* Guide AI-assisted experiences that make system behavior clear, support human review, and handle uncertainty, errors, and recovery
* Stay close to model capabilities and constraints, testing real behavior with engineering rather than relying only on static mockups
* Keep design reviews, documentation, and collaboration useful and lightweight as tools and ways of working evolve

  
  
**Requirements**  

### **What You'll Need**

* 8+ years in product design, including 3+ years directly managing designers, with evidence of helping people grow and perform
* A portfolio showing complex products shipped, your leadership contribution, and the customer or business outcomes achieved
* Strong product judgment, taste, and care for detail. You can explain what needs to improve and help a team get there
* Experience shaping priorities with product and engineering leaders and making clear tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
* Systems thinking and experience building coherent experiences across products
* Practical use of AI in your design workflow and comfort with Figma, interactive prototypes, and technical conversations with engineers
* Clear communication and the ability to influence across teams, resolve disagreements, and connect design decisions to user needs

Nice to have

* Experience designing for healthcare, regulated, or other complex enterprise products
* Experience shipping AI-assisted or agentic experiences
* Ability to prototype, with or without AI assistance
* Experience improving design-system adoption, team workflows, and collaboration

  
  
**Benefits**

Here's What We Offer

* Generous Leave Benefits: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Experience one of the industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical Leave Policy: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer health benefits and insurance to you and your family for medically related expenses related to illness, disease, or injury.
* Pet-Friendly Office\*: Spend more time with your treasured friends, even when you're away from home. Bring your furry friends to the office. \*Noida office only
* Creche Facility for children\*: A convenient and reliable creche facility that puts your child's well-being first. \*India offices

Where and how we work

Our Noida office is situated in a posh techspace, equipped with various amenities to support our work environment. Here, we follow a five-day work schedule, allowing us to efficiently carry out our tasks and collaborate effectively within our team.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer: Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR

department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer Inc. is the data platform that accelerates innovation. The Innovaccer platform unifies patient data across systems and care settings, and empowers healthcare organizations with scalable, modern applications that improve clinical, financial, operational, and experiential outcomes. Innovaccer’s EHR-agnostic solutions have been deployed across more than 1,600

hospitals and clinics in the US, enabling care delivery transformation for more than 96,000 clinicians, and helping providers work collaboratively with payers and life sciences companies.

Innovaccer has helped its customers unify health records for more than 54 million people and generate over $1.5 billion in cumulative cost savings. The Innovaccer platform is the #1 rated Best-in-KLAS data and analytics platform by KLAS, and the #1 rated population health technology platform by Black Book. For more information, please visit innovaccer.com.

Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, and innovaccer.com.
